label: COMPRESS
summary: Operator could compress via Telegram but had to type /vitafeed compress add and could not unwrap machine code to plain text. Fix: Unwrap card shows HUMAN plain + MACHINE wire; bare /vitafeed compress unwrap recovers the latest key; unlock COMPRESS\n recovers bytes; every step is an inline button on root, HOME Compress, HELP, and VITA:\COMPRESS\. Phosphor CRT + library buttons matched on HOME, root, and VITA:\PHOS\.
invariants: HUMAN plain recovered only when sha256 matches
